title: Matrix Product
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Math Functions/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Operations/Matrix_Product.md
text: Multiply matrix elements along rows, columns, or entire input, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode; {Multiply over} sets the dimension over which, {Saturate on integer overflow}, {Intermediate product}, {Product output}, {Accumulator}, {Output}, {Output Minimum}, {Output Maximum} and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Multiply over
params.values: Dimension over which to multiply Columns (default) | Rows | Entire input

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Saturate on integer overflow off (default) | on

params.name: Intermediate product
params.values: Intermediate product data type Inherit: Same as input (default) | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Same as product output (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
